mutation.description: Aggregate discriminator spliced in by ZipMutation; absent when the payload stands alone.

commentUtf8.description: True for UTF-8 EOCD bytes; false for an unambiguous CP437 representation.

description.en: Stores the archive comment as UTF-8 bytes; off stores an unambiguous CP437 form.
description.de: Speichert den Archivkommentar als UTF-8-Bytes; aus speichert eine eindeutige CP437-Form.
